description: This file defines an Angular service class 'ApiService' that provides methods for making HTTP requests to a REST API. It centralizes API URL construction and offers typed helper methods for GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE operations. The class uses Angular's HttpClient and environment configuration for base URL management.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: Angular injectable service providing centralized API request methods with URL handling and typed responses.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Constructs a full URL by appending the provided path to the base API URL, ensuring no duplicate slashes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the constructed URL with optional query parameters, returning an Observable of the response type.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request with the specified body and returns an Observable of the response type.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with the specified body and returns an Observable of the response type.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Performs a PATCH request with the specified body and returns an Observable of the response type.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request with optional query parameters, returning an Observable of the response type.

methods.name: function toHttpParams(query?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null | undefined>): Htt/ toHttpParams

ctags.name: toHttpParams
ctags.pattern: /^function toHttpParams(query?: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null | undefined>): Htt/
